_about: Direct questions (a norm, an institution, a term or a procedure; no fact pattern) for the chat's direct path (ROUTER_ENABLED, PRIMARY_FIRST_ENABLED). Expected articles from general legal knowledge, not from any held-out case; 'any_of' lists accepted alternatives. Run with: python tests/eval_narrative.py --direct (see tests/eval_direct.py). Written 26 Oct 2026, pending lawyer validation.
